figures.finding: No collective agreement sets a Turkish screen actor's pay: the actors' union says employers make about 90% of the sector's workers issue freelance receipts and will not engage actors who refuse, so actors are treated as self-employed traders rather than employees with labour rights.

value.status: actors engaged on freelance receipts (4B-BağKur), outside the Labour Act 4857

figures.applies: Türkiye, film, series and advertising sets, as the union states it in 2026.

sources.said: Çünkü işverenler, sektör çalışanlarının yaklaşık %90’ına zorla serbest meslek makbuzu (4B-BağKur) açtırıyor. Serbest Meslek Makbuzu açmayan oyuncularla ise çalışmıyorlar.
Böylece alanda çalışan tüm işçiler, sistemde kendi nam ve hesabına çalışan bir tüccar gibi görünüyor. Yani çalışma ilişkisi başladığı anda, tüm oyuncuların işçi hakları ellerinden alınıyor.

figures.finding: The one signed rate agreement for Turkish actors covers dubbing only: the Protocol on Dubbing Rules and Minimum Fees between the Stage, Cinema, TV and Dubbing Actors' Union and the dubbing studios that accept it, in force from 1 February 2021 and updated yearly, with minimum fees rising at least by consumer price inflation each year.

value.name: Seslendirme Kuralları ve Taban Ücretlerinin Belirlenmesine Dair Protokol (Protocol on Rules and Determination of Minimum Fee Rates of Dubbing)
parties: Oyuncular Sendikası (Stage, Cinema, TV and Dubbing Actors' Union)
dubbing studios party to the protocol

figures.applies: Türkiye, dubbing work at studios party to the protocol, from 2021-02-01; consolidated text 2024/2025.

sources.said: This protocol herein between the Stage, Cinema, TV and Dubbing Actors’ Union (hereinafter referred to as Actors' Union) residing in Kuloğlu Mah. İstiklal Cad. Erol Dernek Sok. No: 8 Beyoğlu-İSTANBUL and Dubbing Studio(s) and other legal entities (hereinafter refferred to as Dubbing Studio/Dubbing Studios) has been mutually signed.
Bu protokol ile taban ücretlere her yıl en az TÜFE oranında artış garanti altına alınmıştır.

figures.finding: From 1 January 2025 the dubbing protocol's per-minute minimum fees are TL 11.00 for a lead, TL 6.30 for a second-grade and TL 4.20 for a third-grade part in a foreign film or series, TL 62.00, 37.50 and 21.80 for a foreign film dubbed for cinemas, and TL 188.00, 112.00 and 65.50 for a domestic animation.

value.unit: per minute of the dubbed work

figures.applies: Türkiye, dubbing actors at protocol studios, from 2025-01-01 (extras excluded).

figures.finding: Actors' union is the Oyuncular Sendikası (stage, screen and microphone actors), founded in 2011 and a member of the International Federation of Actors (FIA); membership is not required to work, and the union gives legal advice without requiring membership.

figures.finding: Türkiye has a second member of the International Federation of Actors besides the Oyuncular Sendikası: the Contemporary Cinema Actors' Association (Çağdaş Sinema Oyuncuları Derneği, ÇASOD), Istanbul.
